scope: Current, checked-in Minnesota evidence only. This is an inventory and policy boundary, not a topology conversion, source acquisition, or a claim that a renderable Minnesota map exists.

integrity_policy.canonical_text_checksum: For committed text evidence, SHA-256 is computed over UTF-8 content after CRLF is normalized to LF. This matches the checked-in manifest and prevents a Windows checkout line-ending conversion from changing an evidence identity.
integrity_policy.upstream_source_checksum: The aggregate manifest's upstream_sha256_unverified_offline values are recorded author-download claims. The upstream files are not committed here and their bytes are not re-verified by this inventory.

truth_label_policy.rule: The manifest is source-backed metadata only. Its raw-source digests remain unverified_offline and must not be promoted to verified raw data.

accepted_product_artifacts.coverage: Minnesota aggregate-mode source metadata: TIGER counties, MnGeo service areas, EIA-860 county capacity context, and MISO BA context.

coordinate_system.details: TIGER is declared EPSG:4269 and MnGeo service areas EPSG:26915; no corresponding geometry is checked in as a current renderable product artifact.

license_or_terms.details: The checked-in manifest records source URLs but not reusable license terms. Consult and preserve source metadata before distribution.

prohibited_uses: rendering a Minnesota boundary or service-area geometry from absent raw files
topology, line, bus, flow, loading, trip, or outage claims

truth_label_policy.rule: County plant-count and operable summer-capacity values are source-backed aggregate context. A county absent from this file is not a zero-capacity claim.

accepted_product_artifacts.source: EIA Form 860 2024, filtered to Minnesota operable generators through the checked-in aggregate manifest.
accepted_product_artifacts.coverage: 73 Minnesota counties with at least one uniquely county-assigned plant; 836 assigned plants and 18,211.53 MW. The remaining 14 counties are explicitly not zero-capacity claims.

coordinate_system.details: This file contains county FIPS aggregates, not geometry or facility coordinates.

license_or_terms.details: The research inventory describes EIA data as public, but this checked-in output does not preserve a license text.

allowed_uses: aggregate capacity context by county FIPS
clearly labelled aggregate 3D encoding after an accepted county geometry exists
prohibited_uses: demand, dispatch, topology, interconnection, flow, or loading inference

truth_label_policy.rule: The named EIA-860 facility and capacity context are source-backed. Its latitude/longitude fields have no retained coordinate-reference declaration in this product artifact, so coordinate use is unavailable.

accepted_product_artifacts.source: EIA Form 860 2024 unassigned-plant output through the checked-in aggregate manifest.
accepted_product_artifacts.coverage: One Minnesota EIA-860 plant with 1.0 MW retained as unassigned because no exactly-one containing county was established; no nearest-county assignment is permitted.

coordinate_system.details: Latitude and Longitude columns are present, but this checked-in output does not retain their coordinate reference system; it is not an accepted spatial point artifact.

license_or_terms.details: The research inventory describes EIA data as public, but this checked-in output does not preserve a license text.

truth_label_policy.rule: Values are source-backed MISO balancing-authority context in UTC end-of-hour MW. Any Minnesota-only, county, service-area, facility, topology, or flow value derived from them is unavailable unless a separate accepted allocation artifact exists.

accepted_product_artifacts.source: EIA-930 2024 H1, filtered to balancing authority MISO through the checked-in aggregate manifest.
accepted_product_artifacts.coverage: 4,368 MISO balancing-authority hourly records for 2024 H1. It is explicitly not Minnesota demand.

license_or_terms.details: The research inventory describes EIA data as public, but this checked-in output does not preserve a license text.

prohibited_uses: facility dispatch, topology, flow, loading, or outage inference

truth_label_policy.rule: May be shown only as an abstract offline preview. It is not Minnesota, Texas, ERCOT, MISO, or an actual interconnection model.

not_accepted_as_current_product_coverage.reason: The checked-in fixture states this boundary directly; it cannot supply Minnesota topology, geography, facility, scenario, or conclusion coverage.

truth_label_policy.rule: Feasibility observations are not product coverage. A source decision must separately verify fields, units, terms, version, and converter mapping before any topology value could be source_backed.

not_accepted_as_current_product_coverage.reason: The checked-in research record says GridSFM is promising feasibility evidence only; no GridSFM data artifact or validated adapter is accepted in this repository.

truth_label_policy.rule: A source-declared CRS without checked-in geometry is not renderable geographic coverage.

not_accepted_as_current_product_coverage.reason: The manifest records raw TIGER and MnGeo source declarations, but the raw files and a derived geometry artifact are absent from this repository.

asset_taxonomy.truth_label_policy: source_backed only for the accepted EIA-860 county aggregate; an absent county is neither zero nor an asset.
source_backed only with accepted facility identity, coordinate reference, and source coverage; otherwise unavailable. Synthetic and illustrative points must never imply a Minnesota facility.
source_backed only from an accepted, versioned service-area geometry. It represents retail service geography, never a BA map, network, or allocation crosswalk.
source_backed only after the topology decision gate verifies identity, mapping, and source terms; otherwise unavailable.
source_backed only after accepted endpoints or unambiguous geometry and electrical-field provenance; otherwise unavailable.
Flows, loading, trips, and outage values are unavailable unless supplied by an accepted artifact. They must never be inferred from service areas, county capacity, or MISO aggregates.
source_backed only when displayed as MISO balancing-authority context; any Minnesota geographic allocation is unavailable.
synthetic only. It is a non-Minnesota abstract preview and cannot be combined with Minnesota geography or used for Minnesota conclusions.
